Bill.BriefDescription: Revising provisions relating to annexation of territory of certain cities by watersewer districts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to annexation of territory of certain cities bywatersewer districts; and adding a new section to chapter 57.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 57.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: When a district acquires water and/or sewer facilities from a city,and the district and the city within which the facilities are locatedenter into an agreement stating that the district will seek to annexcertain city territory, the district may annex such territory under theprocess in RCW 57.24.010 through 57.24.050, however, the ten percentpetition is not required and the district board of commissioners shallinitiate the annexation by adoption of a resolution calling for thequestion of annexation to be submitted to the voters of the territoryproposed for annexation and setting forth the boundaries thereof. Theresolution shall be filed with the county legislative authority of eachcounty in which the territory proposed to be annexed is located. Uponreceipt of the resolution, the county legislative authority shall causethe meeting in RCW 57.24.010 to be held and the remaining annexation p. 1 HB 1229process to be accomplished. Qualified voters at the date of theelection residing in the territory proposed to be annexed shall bepermitted to vote at the election.
